The '''Rhamalians''' were the native [[Human/Legends|Human]] race who inhabited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhamalai]]. The original colonists who settled Rhamalai were [[Cherishite]]s, who abstained from using modern technology to live a more simpler and rural existence. Over four hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]], the planet's population grew from five hundred to eleven million, and the populace held true to their beliefs, mandating that any outsiders who wished to settle on the planet had to destroy their technology and [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="Rhamalai">{{JournalCite|13|The Occupation of Rhamalai}}</ref>
